evidence: Graesse, Orbis Latinus s.v. Buda: Buda … 2. Ofen (Teil v. Budapest) … auch Ovena, Wuda, Aquincum, Acincum
terms.comment: A town takes no preposition: Budapestinum (to), Budapestinī (in, at), Budapestinō (from).
